scope: Read-only integration review of producer COMMENT receipt and posting consumer; helper not executed.

findings.summary: Posting consumer reads a fixed COMMENT file but does not compare its exact bytes/path with the accepted peer comment_draft binding.
findings.locator: cmm-round93-post-review.py bodypath/body read and request construction; no a[comment_draft] check in supplied source.
findings.impact: Changes to COMMENT bytes after independent acceptance could be posted as if covered by that receipt. Existing Git/PR/CI checks do not bind the review text.
acceptance_checks: Before writing the request or making POST, require actual bodypath equals peer comment_draft.path and actual SHA256 equals peer comment_draft.sha256.
Keep exact producer bytes unchanged and preserve this original source snapshot; static successor confirms narrow guard and correct execution order.

limitations: Preparation-time static finding only; no publication or mismatch was observed and no helper was executed.
